operator_io_quirks: Mixed identifier case: table festival_detail lower, artwork lower, nomination lower; columns Festival_ID/Artwork_ID/Festival_ID capitalized, Type/Name/Result capitalized — must double-quote original spelling.
DDL uses backtick-quoted parent refs (`artwork`("Artwork_ID")) — sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim; backticks are valid sqlite quoting.
Tiny tables (5/9/6 rows) — original_values lists are short; rng.choices(k=min(5,len)) will draw with replacement heavily, so element pool is near-constant.
nomination has composite PK (Artwork_ID, Festival_ID) — both members get max_l0=30 cap; sample_fresh_primary_keys must dedupe on the tuple.
All columns notnull=0 and null_rate=0.0 — no NULLs in original; TS may still emit NULLs from empty parent FK draws.
Location has distinct=1 ('United States') — String sampler length range collapses to [len,len+1]; fresh strings still possible via p.
Year is INT but semantically a year (2006..2010) — dispatches to Number (not Date/Year fuzzer) because declared type is 'INT'; TS will emit arbitrary ints in [-10^scale,10^scale].
Num_of_Audience INT with values 152..161 — Number list range quirk (upper end overwritten to full range) means fresh draws span huge range, not near 152..161.
Type values contain '/' and spaces ('Program Music/Variety Show') — String CHARSET lacks '/', so fresh strings won't reproduce the slash; contamination may add spaces.
Result is a 2-value enum ('Nominated','Won') stored as TEXT — String fuzzer will not respect the enum; fresh strings dominate at p=0.2.
FKs both point to existing parents with unique PKs — fill_foreign_keys_consistently will draw from parent's final filtered column; parent sizes small so child FK values cluster.
No self-FK, no dangling FK, no non-unique parent, no text-stored dates, no storage/declared-type contradiction in this DB.
operator_ts_expectations: festival_detail.Festival_ID, artwork.Artwork_ID: Number fuzzer, single-column PK -> max_l0=inf, so fresh ints dominate; PK dedupe keeps first occurrence.
nomination.Artwork_ID / Festival_ID: composite-PK members -> max_l0=30; also FK children drawing from parent's final column with replacement.
Year: Number fuzzer (declared INT), not Date — TS will produce implausible years (e.g. -9999..9999) -> likely FN on 'Year = 2006'-style gold.
Num_of_Audience: Number fuzzer with list-range quirk -> fresh draws far outside 152..161 -> FN on range/aggregate gold.
Location: String fuzzer, distinct=1 -> element pool is 'United States' repeated; fresh strings at p=0.2 -> FP risk on 'Location = United States'.
Result: String fuzzer -> fresh random strings dominate -> FN on 'Result = Won'/'Nominated' gold; no enum awareness.
Type: String fuzzer -> fresh strings lack '/' -> FN on LIKE '%Music%' style gold; contamination may add spaces.
Festival_Name / Chair_Name / Name: String fuzzer -> random a-zA-Z0-9() strings -> FN on name-equality gold, FP on name-join gold.
nomination FK draws from small parent pools (5 and 9 rows) -> many duplicate (Artwork_ID,Festival_ID) pairs -> PK dedupe shrinks nomination drastically; may under-populate joins -> FN.

choose_table_sizes: w.p. 0.5 flat ~30..230 rows per table, else level-based (level0 1..31, next x4 capped 2500) -> nomination (level 2) can be much larger than parents -> FK draws with replacement produce heavy duplication.
Empty parent (if PK dedupe empties a parent) -> child FK column becomes all NULL -> FN on join gold.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python; rows failing sqlite constraints skipped at insert — here no constraints beyond PK, so few skips.
